scope: Same-study L2 voltage-indicator response validation for 20 ms full-field dark/light flashes; not an independent study or MaleCNS body-ID validation
primary_selection: Author iResp selection, determined with the separate search stimulus; report all other ROIs as secondary sensitivity, never silently discard them
published_parameters: Frozen reproduction only: selected ROI mean exactly reproduces author L2_highLum training data
cross_validation: Leave one entire fly out. Fit all response parameters, latency, normalization and control parameters on equal-weight training-fly means only. No test-ROI gain, baseline or lag adjustment.
model: Author recurrent equation family reimplemented in source dF/F observable units; integrate a nominal 20 ms box with fitted training-only delay, then average each prediction over (t-1/120,t] to match the author moving-average code. One effective fluorescence observable, not absolute membrane voltage. Isolated-flash zero-state approximation.
controls: Feedback-free dynamics separately fitted on training flies
metrics: Dark/light primary peak magnitude and time in 0-80 ms
reliability: Odd/even stimulus repetitions re-binned from published normalized time series. Descriptive split-half repeatability, no claim of a precise noise ceiling.
uncertainty: Equal-weight fly-level summaries and percentile bootstrap over flies (seed 20260927, 5000 resamples); descriptive across overlapping CV folds
predeclared_assessment: Report continuous errors without declaring all cells biologically validated. Test whether paired fly RMSE improvement versus separately fitted feedback-free control has a positive 95% bootstrap lower bound. Expose failures and boundary-hitting parameters.
limitations: Same study and stimulus class; model architecture selected by this literature
Processed ROI traces, not a new analysis of raw microscope images
Fluorescence response, not mV or Hz
Female source specimens are not MaleCNS identity-matched
No spatial receptive-field, spectral, camera radiometric or full-brain validation
Nominal flash waveform and bin timing, not per-trial photodiode waveform fitting
Potential cell identity overlap across fields of view; ROI records are grouped by fly
